setup.contextPolicy: new Playwright BrowserContext and page for every measured navigation; no context is reused
setup.cacheScope: browser-context HTTP cache and storage are fresh per sample; Chromium process, OS filesystem/page cache, DNS cache and local preview server may be warm
setup.previewServer: scripts/serve-static.mjs sends Cache-Control: no-store and uncompressed response bodies
setup.end: first accepted balanced cha-waves:field-diagnostic event, emitted synchronously after Canvas draw in the app requestAnimationFrame callback

scope: Measures from the document navigation time origin through the first accepted balanced field result draw in Canvas, reported by the app diagnostic event after its requestAnimationFrame draw callback. It covers local preview document/assets, app startup, worker startup and solve, and accepted-result Canvas drawing. It does not measure compositor submission, display presentation, input-to-display latency, real-device behavior, physical room accuracy, or cold OS/DNS/network caches.

resourceTransferObservations.description: Per-sample Navigation Timing and Resource Timing sizes captured at the first accepted balanced diagnostic. Browser cache behavior can make transferSize zero; values describe Chromium observations only.
